gatoh.agents.AgentSet.get_index

AgentSet.get_index(agent: Agent) → int[source]

Returns the index within the AgentSet of the input Agent object.

Parameters:

agent (Agent) – The agent whose index is being searched for.

Raises:

KeyError – If the input Agent does not exist in the AgentSet.

Returns:

The index of the agent within the AgentSet.

Return type:

int
